notes: Curated by droidxfer. Ratings are deliberately conservative. safe: removing it only removes that app; probably_safe: you lose the feature described; advanced: other apps or core features depend on it; unsafe: can break the phone. Patterns apply only to packages that neither droidxfer's list nor the community list rates.
